acceptance: A bundle written by this tree reports result_schema_version 2.3 and validates; unit tests show every new field's key order and that absent producers leave the fields absent, not null-filled
Schema 2.2 bundles (fixture copies of existing results-data bundles) load without error and read as execution_engine requested=default with applied and observed unknown

Legacy mapping unit tests: platform_options.streaming=true reads as requested=streaming/resolution=legacy_option; a bundle carrying platform.config.engine_requested=in-memory reads as requested=in-memory/resolution=explicit; engine_requested=default reads as resolution=version_default
derive_variant_id has unit tests for platform only, +engine, ~deployment, @gateway and combinations, matching ADR D8 exactly, and platform.variant carries its output

Anonymizer tests: execution_engine values stay readable inside config and platform blocks; compute_resource follows the ADR D7 decision; the existing Firebolt engine/enginename hashing and the publication fixed-point gates still pass

Results-data and Explorer compatibility gates pass: results-data validation (results-data/validate_corpus.py) and scripts/publication/check_explorer_compat.py, or the documented schema-bump procedure is followed and named in the PR
PR merged through the normal flow; production diff about 300 lines or less excluding tests, or the split was agreed
context:
Decision gates:
- G1 Start only after core-exec-framework-manifest is done.
- G2 If the version bump requires re-deriving results-data/ or changes any published byte of existing corpus bundles, stop and get user approval; the change must be additive.
- G3 If the anonymizer decision in ADR D7 cannot be implemented without weakening the fixed-point or privacy gates, stop and amend the ADR.

Verification rubric: unit tests for schema, loader, builder and anonymizer; make pr-preflight fast lane; the results-data check target used by CI; a polars-df tpch SF 0.01 run's bundle inspected for result_schema_version 2.3 and the absence of producer-less fields.

Guardrails: shared core-exec guardrails (see core-exec-d0-vocabulary-adr context). Never edit results-data/ bundles by hand.
description:
Add the result-bundle fields the ADR defines so every later item has somewhere to record requested, applied and observed values, and so old bundles map onto the new fields.

Work:
1. Schema 2.3 (additive): CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION and KNOWN_SCHEMA_V2_VERSIONS in benchbox/core/results/schema_policy.py; key order in core/results/schema_specs.yaml for config.execution_engine, platform.execution_engine, queries[].execution_engine, platform.compute.{resource, resource_kind, size}, platform.gateway, platform.deployment.{selected, selected_class} (fields stay absent until a producer fills them).
2. Builder plumbing: RunConfigInput carries execution_engine (core/results/builder.py); platform.execution_engine is taken from the adapter's resolve_execution_engine receipt as returned in get_platform_info()["execution_engine"] (core/results/schema.py _build_platform_section).
3. platform.variant (unused today, core/results/schema.py:215,469) holds the variant_id string (for example polars-df+streaming) computed by one core function derive_variant_id(platform, deployment, requested_engine, gateway) per ADR D8. Display labels ("Polars (streaming)") are derived separately by the Explorer item and are not stored here.
4. Legacy mapping in the loader: a 2.2 bundle reads as requested=default with applied/observed unknown; platform_options.streaming=true maps to requested=streaming with resolution=legacy_option; platform.config.engine_requested (the Polars matrix bundles) maps to requested with resolution=explicit, except `default`, which maps to resolution=version_default.
5. Anonymizer (anonymization_specs.yaml, anonymization.py) per ADR D7: core vocabulary keys stay readable; compute_resource follows the D7 decision (drop or hash); gateway host goes with endpoint keys. Keep the Polars `engine` exemption until core-exec-polars-cli-mcp-adoption removes the option.
6. docs/reference/result-formats.md version table and field reference; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry for schema 2.3.
